findings.issue: New text intent keeps an old result, which can be returned by ACTION_PROCESS_TEXT.

findings.issue: Cancellation during serialization can still open/truncate the destination later.
findings.suggestion: Check interruption before/after serialization and before opening output; check between bounded writes. Already opened provider files cannot be generically rolled back.

findings.suggestion: Use result bounds 48000 per field, retaining 12000 only for editable draft.

findings.issue: alive/generation check omits isFinishing/isDestroyed before dialog-producing callbacks.
findings.suggestion: Add lifecycle finish/destroy checks before done(value).
